description:
Job Profile- Oracle 10g VB6 MVC Developer
Duration- 24 Months
Location- Albany, NY

Candidates should have at least 60 months experience, and at least one of the following should apply
1.    Experience with C# .Net.
2.    Experience with Oracle 10G. (NOTE: Microsoft SQL Server and MS Access are NOT considered valid database experience and should NOT be part of the 72 months experience)
3.    Experience with VB6.
4.    Experience with MVC.
5.    Experience with Web Services, XML.
6.    Experience with Oracle PL/SQL.
7.    Experience interpreting and analyzing complex business requirements and building the logic within an application's code to meet those requirements.
8.    Experience with large data sets (> 10 million rows).

 



 If you are interested in finding out more about opportunities near you, if you are in need of a staffing firm such as ours, or if you just have a question regarding your resume and career path, please email me at ryan askitc.com
